title: Australian Broadcasting Corporation Amendment (Regional Australia) Bill 2017
short_title: Australian Broadcasting Corporation Amendment (Regional Australia) Bill 2017

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would require the Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC) to direct a minimum share of its annual spending to regional, rural and remote Australia.
At least 35 per cent of the ABC's money applied each financial year would have to fund payments to people in those areas.
The spending requirement and reporting changes would begin the day after Royal Assent, with a special rule for the first partial financial year.
changes: The ABC's statutory rules for using its money would include a regional payment requirement.
Annual reports would have to disclose the amount paid to people in regional, rural and remote areas.
If commencement occurred during a financial year, the remaining period would count as a financial year for these provisions.
summary.affected: The ABC and people receiving its payments in regional, rural and remote Australia are affected.
